C539  Cervix uteri

**Note 1:** This schema is based on the UICC chapter *Cervix Uteri,* pages 206-211.
* Primary sites C538 and C539 are listed in the chapter heading but are not specified in the anatomic subsites in this chapter of the UICC manual; however, they are included in this schema and TNM staged if appropriate histology criteria are met

**Note 2:**  TNM values are based on the stages accepted by the Federation Internationale de Gynecologic et d'Obstetrique (FIGO).

**Note 3:** The FIGO stages are based on clinical staging. Some Stage I subdivisions require histologic examination of the cervix. (TNM stages are based on clinical and/or pathologic classification). 

**Note 4:** In addition to directly assigning TNM, Summary Stage 2000 (SS2000) must be captured.  If directly assigning SS2000, use the *Cervix* chapter on page 204 of the [SS2000 on-line manual](https://seer.cancer.gov/tools/ssm/ssm2000/SSSM2000-122012.pdf#page=204).
